fact: ARCOP says it is continuing to deploy the APPEL e-procurement platform, with generalisation targeted from January 2027, a 1 December 2026 deadline to load 2027 procurement plans onto it, and training for more than 325 contracting authorities.

ARCOP launched on 4 December 2025 the territorial rollout of the APPEL platform (achatspublics.sn), a three-month caravan enrolling contracting authorities and training users, saying all procedures will be fully dematerialised at the end.
ARCOP says it inaugurated the APPEL electronic public procurement platform on 14 October 2025, where tender notices are published, tender files sent to the DCMP and bids submitted online.

ARCOP says the APPEL e-procurement platform, launched in pilot on 14 October 2025, has had 15 procedures launched, nine with electronic opening of bids, and publishes procurement plans, tenders and bid openings online.
ARCOP gives figures for APPEL: nearly 400 registered suppliers, over 80 procurement plans published for 2025 and since January 2026, and 15 procedures launched, nine with electronic opening of bids.
